quests.title: Kamla's Berries

dialogue.t: You must have seen my post and came here to deliver the Berries, right?
So, did you get fifteen Berries?

dialogue.sit: Here are the berries you wanted.

dialogue.t: I'll take them back to dry. Then I'll have dried berries again for my next trip to the sea.

quests.description: Kamla from Port Ormos needs fifteen Berries.
